CLIENT INSIGHTS / LEGACY

A little preparation.
Greater clarity.

A valid will records your wishes for the distribution of your estate. If you die without a valid will, the law of intestate succession applies.

Before you speak to a professional

  • List your assets, debts and the people you want to provide for.
  • Consider whom you would like to nominate as executor.
  • Discuss arrangements for minor children with a qualified professional.
  • Review your will when your family or circumstances change.
  • Keep the original safely and tell someone you trust where it is.

Signing and witnessing requirements matter. Get qualified South African legal help to ensure your will is valid and appropriate for your circumstances.
